notes:
Valheim Data: the Food filter and the Class filter, done right.

- Item Type: Food now shows every food material, not just what you can eat raw. Raw meat (Asksvin Tail, Deer Meat...), Barley, eggs that go into recipes, Bloodbag, Blood Clot and the rest are all there. The Asksvin Egg is gone: it hatches, nothing cooks with it.
- Class now means what it says. Raw = gathered, never made. Crafted = anything you make. Item = a finished thing you use. Eyescream, Bread and a Bronze Sword are Crafted and an Item; Barley Flour and Bread Dough are Crafted only.
- Eggs and Turnip aren't edible raw any more, and Bukeperries and Toadstool no longer count as food.
- MegaLoad stops logging a failed data fetch every 15 minutes when nothing has changed.
